subject: Agriculture
title: Fertile Crescent to Desert
description: A fast breakdown of Fertile Crescent to Desert for builders.

hook.text: The Fertile Crescent, where farming began, is now mostly arid land. The soil that built empires is gone.

buildup.text: Irrigation brought salt. Deforestation exposed hillsides to erosion. Overgrazing stripped vegetation.

discovery.text: Mesopotamian records show declining yields over centuries. Farmers switched from wheat to salt-tolerant barley.

twist.text: Civilizations didn't realize they were destroying their soil base. The decline was too slow to notice.

climax.text: When the soil gave out, so did the civilization. No soil, no food, no city.

punchline.text: History's greatest empires fell from the ground up.

quiz.question: Why did Mesopotamian farmers switch from wheat to barley?
options: Barley tolerated the salt that was accumulating in irrigated soil
